arStrings.szText:
When you find the {c_important}District Boss{/c} you gain the {c_important}Initiative{/c} buff, which has a duration equal to your remaining {c_important}Time{/c}. {c_important}Initiative{/c} is lost upon death.

If you slay the {c_important}District Boss{/c} with {c_important}Initiative{/c} active, you receive {c_important}{u}{b}Tribute{/b}{/u}{/c} rewards as if your {c_important}{u}{b}Attunement{/b}{/u}{/c} was {c_number}2{/c} higher (max {c_number}6{/c}).

All enemies within the {c_important}Undercity{/c} have +{c_number}1{/c} {c_important}{b}{u}Monster Power{/c}{/b}{/u}.
